post.description: Validates the backup (integrity check, known migration revision) and stages it. The live database is not touched: the staged file replaces it at the next startup, and the previous database is kept as pre-restore-<timestamp>.db. All sessions are signed out after a restore. Pass restart=true to shut the app down gracefully after responding so the container's restart policy brings it back.
